name: @dreamteamer/notebooklm
description: dt notebooklm — export a dreamteamer workspace to a NotebookLM notebook, and keep NOTEBOOKLM.md current.

dreamteamer.title: NotebookLM
dreamteamer.description: Renders the workspace for NotebookLM: `dt notebooklm` writes the schema, the records and a persona as a bounded set of sources (and, given a notebook, syncs them), and the `notebooklm` harness keeps NOTEBOOKLM.md's configuration block current. Collections marked `sensitive: true` and fields marked `x-sensitive: true` never travel.
